question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined phrase in the following sentence.

She was known for her __ability to communicate effectively and express herself clearly in writing and speaking__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"articulation"** means the act of expressing something in a coherent verbal form; the ability to speak clearly and effectively. (स्पष्टता)

 
 
• **Example: **Her articulation during the presentation impressed everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **"Articulation"** refers to the clear and effective expression of ideas in speech or writing. (स्पष्टता)
 
 
• **Example: **Good articulation is crucial for public speakers and educators.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Incoherence** (असंगति): Lack of clarity or organization in thought or speech.

 
 
• **Example:** His incoherence made it difficult to understand his point.
 
 
 
• **Mumbling** (बड़बड़ाना): Speaking in a quiet and unclear manner.
 
 
• **Example:** He was mumbling so softly that no one could hear him.
 
 
 
• **Rambling** (असंगत बात करना): Talking or writing in a lengthy and confused way.
 
 
• **Example:** His speech was so rambling that it was hard to follow his main points.
